name: VRP harvest — IV>RV spread calm-window long (4h)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM: trade the IV-vs-RV SPREAD directly, not dvol as a standalone gate. When dvol (30d implied) sits materially ABOVE trailing vol_realized, the crypto options market is charging a fat variance risk premium — dealers/market-makers demand it because they are structurally SHORT gamma to a retail flow that persistently overpays for convexity/hedges (documented VRP, Deribit 2025). We cannot sell options, so we harvest the proxy: a wide IV>RV gap forecasts realized vol UNDERSHOOTS implied, i.e. the coming window is calmer-than-priced -> favors a mean-reversion/carry-style spot long held into the calm, NOT a breakout. Entry: dvol clears a fitted floor (options pricing a premium) AND vol_realized sits below a fitted ceiling (realized already calm relative to that implied level) AND rsi is not overbought (not chasing a top). The other side of our trade is the option BUYER (hedgers, event-punters) who rationally overpays for tail insurance; we are the patient seller of that fear. Persists because the insurance demand is behavioral/structural, not arbitraged away by spot traders who can't touch the options book. Exit: rsi crosses up into overbought (calm-drift exhausted) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: substitute dvol ALONE (drop the vol_realized ceiling leg) — if the single-gauge read matches the deflated Sharpe, the SPREAD carries no information beyond 'IV is high' and this collapses into the already-tested dvol-spike specs. DISCONFIRMER 2: if an unconditional calm-window long over the same sample/costs matches it, the VRP adds nothing. HARD CAVEAT: only ~148 DVOL points exist -> paper-only, non-fundable until the series deepens; net of ~20bps round-trip the spot proxy is a weak shadow of the real short-vol trade.
catalyst: implied vol priced above realized — a fat variance risk premium into a calmer-than-priced window
